radiatR: Analyse and Visualise Headings and Trajectories on the Unit Disk

Source: R/radiatR-package.R
radiatR-package.Rd

A complete pipeline for analysing directional data – headings and trajectories on the unit disk. Supply a table of angles directly, or reconstruct headings from movement trajectories imported from tracking tools ('EthoVision', 'DeepLabCut', 'SLEAP', 'TRex', 'ANY-maze', 'TrackMate', 'idtracker.ai', and others) via a unified dialect-based loader system, including multi-bodypart pose estimation with likelihood-weighted centroid. Derives per-trial heading directions using multiple rules (ring-crossing, distal point, pose body-axis, velocity-based, and more). Computes circular statistics including mean direction, resultant length, von Mises and wrapped Cauchy parametric fits, circular correlation (circular-linear and circular-circular), circular-linear regression (Fisher and Lee (1992) doi:10.2307/2532334 ), model selection among orientation models (Fitak and Johnsen (2017) doi:10.1242/jeb.167056 ), and uniformity and multi-sample hypothesis tests (Rayleigh, Watson-Williams, Hermans-Rasson (Landler, Ruxton and Malkemper (2019) doi:10.1186/s12898-019-0246-8 ), and others) with multiple-comparison correction. Path tortuosity follows Benhamou (2004) doi:10.1016/j.jtbi.2004.03.016 . Renders publication-quality 'ggplot2' radial plots with overlaid rose diagrams, parametric density curves, non-parametric kernel density estimates, and circular boxplots (Buttarazzi, Pandolfo and Porzio (2018) doi:10.1111/biom.12889 ). Includes a browser-based 'shiny' graphical interface requiring no R coding via launch_app().

American spellings

Every `colour...` argument and the `assign_colour_*` / `cycle_colours` / `hf_colour_col` functions accept the American `color...` spelling as an alias (e.g. `color`, `color_col`, `track_color`). British spelling is canonical; supplying both spellings of a pair is an error.
